subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up work preserve the current `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` and node-approval gates while investigating Android command advertising and A2UI readiness, or intentionally change the camera/location command authorization contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both command implementations and security gates; automation should not broaden exposure from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep `camera.snap` and `camera.clip` behind explicit gateway opt-in, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, setting, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden camera or location exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after live proof
options.body: If live proof shows independent camera, location, and A2UI causes, split the work into separate owner-reviewed issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep `camera.snap` and `camera.clip` behind explicit gateway opt-in, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, setting, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The current central files and latest declaration-localization history point to vincentkoc as the best available routing owner for the command-surface/security-boundary decision.
